notice: Small curated general educational information set. Not a clinical guideline, diagnosis, or individualized care plan. No medicine or dosage recommendations.

topics.label: cough
comfort_steps: Rest and drink fluids; a warm drink may feel soothing. Keep drinks warm rather than scalding.
Honey may soothe a cough for people older than one year. Never give honey to a child under one year.
Avoid smoke and vaping where possible.
seek_help: Contact a healthcare professional if the cough is worsening, not improving, or worrying you.
urgent_signs: Get urgent medical help for severe difficulty breathing, blue or grey lips, severe chest pain, coughing up blood, or new confusion.

topics.label: fever
comfort_steps: Rest, drink fluids regularly, and wear comfortable light clothing.
Keep the room comfortably ventilated and avoid trying to cool yourself with ice or very cold baths.
seek_help: Contact a healthcare professional if you feel very unwell, the fever is worsening or not settling, or you are concerned.
Seek professional advice promptly for a fever in a very young infant or if you have a condition that increases infection risk.
urgent_signs: Get urgent medical help for difficulty breathing, new confusion, a seizure, fainting, or rapid worsening.

topics.label: cold symptoms
comfort_steps: Rest and drink fluids; warm drinks may feel soothing if your throat is irritated.
A clean cool-mist humidifier may make the air feel more comfortable. Avoid bowls of boiling water because of burn risk.
seek_help: Contact a healthcare professional if symptoms are worsening, last longer than expected, or are concerning to you.
urgent_signs: Get urgent medical help for severe difficulty breathing, blue or grey lips, new confusion, or rapid worsening.

topics.label: stomach or abdominal pain
comfort_steps: Rest and take small sips of fluid if that feels comfortable.
Avoid forcing food; choose small, simple portions only if you feel able to eat.
seek_help: Contact a healthcare professional if the pain persists, returns, worsens, or concerns you.
urgent_signs: Get urgent medical help for sudden or severe pain, fainting, blood in vomit or stool, or a rapidly worsening condition.

topics.label: sore throat
comfort_steps: Drink fluids and rest; warm or cool drinks may feel soothing.
Avoid smoke and other throat irritants.
seek_help: Contact a healthcare professional if symptoms worsen, persist, or make it difficult to drink.
urgent_signs: Get urgent medical help for difficulty breathing, inability to swallow saliva, or rapid swelling in the throat.

topics.label: headache
comfort_steps: Rest somewhere quiet, drink water, and try not to skip meals.
Taking a break from bright screens may help if they make you feel worse.
seek_help: Contact a healthcare professional if the headache is new, recurring, worsening, or concerning.
urgent_signs: Get urgent medical help for a sudden severe headache, weakness on one side, new confusion, fainting, or a headache after a significant head injury.

topics.label: nasal congestion
comfort_steps: Drink fluids and rest.
A clean cool-mist humidifier or a comfortable warm shower may feel soothing. Avoid bowls of boiling water because of burn risk.
seek_help: Contact a healthcare professional if symptoms are worsening, persistent, or concerning.
urgent_signs: Get urgent medical help if congestion comes with severe difficulty breathing, blue or grey lips, or rapid worsening.

topics.label: nausea
comfort_steps: Try small, frequent sips of water or other suitable fluids.
When you feel able, small portions of simple foods may be easier than a large meal.
seek_help: Contact a healthcare professional if nausea persists, worsens, or you cannot keep fluids down.
urgent_signs: Get urgent medical help for severe abdominal pain, fainting, blood in vomit, or signs of severe dehydration.

topics.label: diarrhea
comfort_steps: Take frequent small sips of fluids to help replace what is lost.
Rest and eat what you can tolerate; avoid forcing large meals.
seek_help: Contact a healthcare professional if it persists, worsens, or you are concerned, especially for a young child or someone medically vulnerable.
urgent_signs: Get urgent medical help for blood in stool, severe pain, fainting, confusion, or signs of severe dehydration.

topics.label: fatigue
comfort_steps: Try to rest, keep a comfortable sleep routine, and drink fluids.
If you feel up to it, gentle activity and regular meals may be easier than pushing through exhaustion.
seek_help: Contact a healthcare professional if fatigue is persistent, worsening, unexplained, or affecting daily activities.
urgent_signs: Get urgent medical help for fainting, new confusion, severe difficulty breathing, or sudden weakness.
